integrity: Proof is self-contained for the stated exact counting and all-n threshold. Standalone exhaustive checks are finite confirmations, not substitutes for that proof. No independent mathematical audit has been performed.
scientific_limitations: The general fixed-vertex count is exact for finite commutative rings, but the maximum-degree support classification is restricted to Boolean products at uniformity three. Historical priority of rooted-cover enumerations remains provisional.
title: A sharp vertex-degree transition in three-uniform minimal comaximal hypergraphs
